headline_marked: Tomatoes ৳200/kg: [[High prices of essentials squeeze Dhaka consumers]]
headline: Tomatoes ৳200/kg: High prices of essentials squeeze Dhaka consumers
summary: Most vegetables are priced between ৳50 and ৳120 per kg, while tomatoes have surged to over ৳200 per kg in the capital's markets.
details: Consumers in Dhaka are struggling with the high cost of essential vegetables, despite no shortage in supply. Most common vegetables are now priced between ৳50 and ৳120 per kg.
Tomatoes have become particularly unaffordable, with prices reaching between ৳180 and ৳200 per kg. Green chilies are selling for ৳150 per kg.
Other vegetables like flat beans (shim) are ৳120 per kg, while bitter gourd, pointed gourd, and okra are priced between ৳80 and ৳90 per kg. Eggplants vary from ৳80 to ৳140 per kg.
Only a few items like raw papaya and pumpkin remain relatively affordable, with most other vegetables costing more than ৳80 per kg.
Protein sources are also expensive. Red eggs are ৳150 per dozen, white eggs ৳140 per dozen, and duck eggs ৳180-৳185 per dozen.
Chicken prices remain high, with broiler chicken at ৳190-৳200 per kg and desi chicken at ৳700 per kg. Beef is selling for around ৳800 per kg and mutton at ৳1,250 per kg.
caption:
Tomatoes at ৳200/kg and eggs at ৳150/dozen. Dhaka consumers are feeling the pinch as essential food prices soar.

Consumers in Dhaka are struggling with the high cost of essential vegetables, despite no shortage in supply. Most common vegetables are now priced between ৳50 and ৳120 per kg.

Tomatoes have become particularly unaffordable, with prices reaching between ৳180 and ৳200 per kg. Green chilies are selling for ৳150 per kg.

Other vegetables like flat beans (shim) are ৳120 per kg, while bitter gourd, pointed gourd, and okra are priced between ৳80 and ৳90 per kg. Eggplants vary from ৳80 to ৳140 per kg.

Only a few items like raw papaya and pumpkin remain relatively affordable, with most other vegetables costing more than ৳80 per kg.

Protein sources are also expensive. Red eggs are ৳150 per dozen, white eggs ৳140 per dozen, and duck eggs ৳180-৳185 per dozen.

Chicken prices remain high, with broiler chicken at ৳190-৳200 per kg and desi chicken at ৳700 per kg. Beef is selling for around ৳800 per kg and mutton at ৳1,250 per kg.

headline_marked: 33,851 mandaps set up as [[Durga Puja begins across Bangladesh]]
headline: 33,851 mandaps set up as Durga Puja begins across Bangladesh
summary: The five-day festival starts with Maha Shashti, featuring elaborate decorations and widespread celebrations across the country.
details: The main religious festival of the Bengali Hindu community, Sharadiya Durga Puja, began on Friday, October 16, with Maha Shashti.
caption:
33,851 mandaps across Bangladesh are ready for Durga Puja, an increase of 1,500 from last year.

The main religious festival of the Bengali Hindu community, Sharadiya Durga Puja, began on Friday, October 16, with Maha Shashti.
